name: xhs-search-recommend
doc: search discovery words (capability D SuggestWords on xhs). Evidence: corpus 111 req GET /api/sns/web/v1/search/recommend?keyword=... -> {success, msg, code:1000, data{word_request_id, sug_items[10x{highlight_flags, search_type:"notes", type:"top_note", text}], search_cpl_id}}; words = input prefix + category-suffixed completions (first word always an extension word; suffix pools category-partitioned), highlight_flags true for the first len(keyword) chars. Real-site signing rides the edith x-s header family (same face as search); the synth oracle accepts unsigned calls. Empty keyword returns the static hot-word pool (10).
